en-US.longDescription: ICE Excel Add-In integrates seamlessly into your existing Microsoft Excel environment, providing fast access to real-time and historical market data. It takes advantage of the flexibility of Excel to provide users with an environment to perform complex market data analysis.
en-US.name: ICE XL
